## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `reachability-basis-aware-lineage`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-08-13T08:51:22.149Z.

Signal candidate (41) — reachability-basis-aware lineage weight, measured 2026-08-13. Candidates (39) and (40) both weight an edge by properties of the edge: whether other edges imply it, and how rare its kind is in the corpus. This candidate weights an edge by whether the project's own governance can currently traverse it, which is a third and independent property, and it is the first candidate whose motivating measurement shows a signal the engine would compute correctly being contradicted by the surface that scores the corpus.

The measurement. Typed-outcome reachability in src/sdk/graph/governance.ts is documented on every field as "a typed hierarchy or implements path to an outcome". The admitted basis is therefore three kinds: parent, child, implements. Recomputing inward from the six outcome milestones plus pm-doxj with --kind parent,child,implements reaches 2,443 of 2,455 items. Recomputing with the basis unrestricted reaches all 2,455. The twelve-item difference is pm-doxj, which is the index root rather than an outcome, and eleven canceled items — eight archived PRD-era epics and three probe items.

Live edge census the same day: implements 2,602, parent 2,280, child 0 after this session's duplicate-spelling collapse; against discovered_from 502, verifies 259, supersedes 84, incident_from 4, for 849 edges the audit itself labels semantic. Every one of those 849 contributes zero to the reachability numbers that three block-enforcement assertions read.

Why this is a relevance signal and not only a governance defect. The engine's purpose is to rank by how much context an item carries about the work at hand. Distance-to-outcome is one of the strongest such signals and this epic already carries outcome-distance-prior as a candidate. That prior is computed over a basis, and if it inherits governance's basis it inherits a specific bias: an item whose only lineage is supersedes or discovered_from scores as infinitely distant from every outcome, which is exactly backwards, because discovered_from is the edge that records why the work exists at all and supersedes is the edge that records what replaced it.

The candidate. Compute the lineage weight over the full semantic basis, and carry the basis as an explicit parameter rather than inheriting it. Then weight each admitted kind by how much the corpus lets it explain: hierarchy kinds carry containment, implements carries intent, discovered_from carries causation, supersedes carries succession, verifies carries evidence. The weight is per-kind and declared, not learned, so the ranking stays explainable and reproducible.

The concrete asymmetry the weight has to encode, because it is not symmetric. supersedes declares no inverse in the built-in ontology, and neither do discovered_from, implements, verifies or incident_from — five of the ten kinds are directed with no reverse spelling. For implements that is harmless: the edge is stored on the implementing item and already points at the outcome. For supersedes it inverts the signal: the edge is stored on the living item and points at the dead one, so the archived item has only an incoming edge and no outward path to anything current. pm-9rgaal, itself an outcome milestone, records supersedes at pm-6hhn — the correct statement of what happened — and pm-6hhn still scores as unreachable. A lineage weight that reads outgoing edges only will therefore rank every superseded item as context-free, which is the opposite of true: a superseded item is the single best explanation of why its replacement is shaped the way it is.

So the candidate has two halves and they must ship together: traverse the full semantic basis, and traverse it in both orientations with per-direction weights, so succession reads forward from the replacement and backward from the archive.

Degeneracy, checked as this epic requires. On a workspace with no semantic edges the weight reduces to the hierarchy-and-implements basis already in use, so the ranking is identical and the signal is a no-op — true of every fresh workspace and every small project. On a workspace with no edges at all it is identically zero and the ranking falls back to the metadata and history signals. Neither case needs a special path.

Filed as governance defects this session, so the engine does not have to work around them permanently: pm-ayg31c for the basis admitting three of ten kinds, and the inverse-spelling asymmetry recorded on it.

Scope clarification from individual-ownership review: pm-ayg31c owns a related measurement, read primitive or defect fix. It does not independently deliver this proposed ranking behavior. Reuse its evidence and public API; evaluate the additional behavior in this experiment.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.

Define a versioned public-SDK input/output and parameter contract, with exact source receipts and bounded time, memory and token complexity.; Implement an isolated reproducible prototype and compare held-out quality, task success, costs, cold-start behavior and negative controls against the unchanged baseline.; Record an accept, reject, or defer decision with evidence; production implementation requires an accepted decision and its own linked delivery scope.
A falsifiable decision on reachability basis aware lineage with reusable benchmark evidence and no unreviewed production policy change.
